sn6.6:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
sn6.6:1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā divāvihāragato hoti paṭisallīno.
sn6.6:1.3: atha kho subrahmā ca paccekabrahmā suddhāvāso ca paccekabrahmā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā paccekaṃ dvārabāhaṃ upanissāya aṭṭhaṃsu. atha kho subrahmā paccekabrahmā suddhāvāsaṃ paccekabrahmānaṃ etadavoca:
sn6.6:1.4: akālo kho tāva mārisa bhagavantaṃ payirupāsituṃ.
sn6.6:1.6: asuko ca brahmaloko iddho ceva phīto ca. brahmā ca tatra pamādavihāraṃ viharati.
sn6.6:1.7: āyāma mārisa yena so brahmaloko tenupasaṅkamissāma. upasaṅkamitvā taṃ brahmānaṃ saṃvejeyyāmāti.
sn6.6:1.8: evaṃ mārisāti kho suddhāvāso paccekabrahmā subrahmuno paccekabrahmuno paccassosi.
sn6.6:2.1: atha kho subrahmā ca paccekabrahmā suddhāvāso ca paccekabrahmā seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya evameva bhagavato purato antarahitā tasmiṃ brahmaloke pāturahesuṃ.
sn6.6:2.2: addasā kho so brahmā te brahmāno dūratova āgacchante. disvāna te brahmāno etadavoca:
sn6.6:2.3: handa kuto nu tumhe mārisā āgacchathāti.
sn6.6:2.4: atha kho mayaṃ mārisa āgacchāma tassa bhagavato santikā arahato sammāsambuddhassa.
sn6.6:2.5: gaccheyyāsi pana tvaṃ mārisa tassa bhagavato upaṭṭhānaṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassāti.
sn6.6:3.1: evaṃ vutto kho so brahmā taṃ vacanaṃ anadhivāsento sahassakkhattuṃ attānaṃ abhinimminitvā subrahmānaṃ paccekabrahmānaṃ etadavoca:
sn6.6:3.2: passasi me no tvaṃ mārisa evarūpaṃ iddhānubhāvanti.
sn6.6:3.3: passāmi kho tyāhaṃ mārisa evarūpaṃ iddhānubhāvanti.
sn6.6:3.4: so khvāhaṃ mārisa evaṃ mahiddhiko evaṃ mahānubhāvo kassa aññassa samaṇassa vā brāhmaṇassa vā upaṭṭhānaṃ gamissāmīti.
sn6.6:4.1: atha kho subrahmā paccekabrahmā dvisahassakkhattuṃ attānaṃ abhinimminitvā taṃ brahmānaṃ etadavoca:
sn6.6:4.2: passasi me no tvaṃ mārisa evarūpaṃ taṃ iddhānubhāvanti.
sn6.6:4.3: passāmi kho tyāhaṃ mārisa evarūpaṃ iddhānubhāvanti.
sn6.6:4.4: tayā ca kho mārisa mayā ca sveva bhagavā mahiddhikataro ceva mahānubhāvataro ca.
sn6.6:4.5: gaccheyyāsi tvaṃ mārisa tassa bhagavato upaṭṭhānaṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassāti.
sn6.6:4.6: atha kho so brahmā subrahmānaṃ paccekabrahmānaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi:
sn6.6:7.1: atha kho subrahmā ca paccekabrahmā suddhāvāso ca paccekabrahmā taṃ brahmānaṃ saṃvejetvā tatthevantaradhāyiṃsu.
sn6.6:7.2: agamāsi ca kho so brahmā aparena samayena bhagavato upaṭṭhānaṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassāti.
